raw_segments.text: Others, and the great oath waxeth weak, and Ruth, as a thing outstriven, is fled, fled
from the shores of the Greek, away on the winds of heaven.
Dark is the house afar, where an old king called thee daughter, all that was once thy
star in stormy water dark, and low in the nearer house that was sworn to love thee another
queenlier dearer is thrown above thee.
